snippet.title: All Hands on Deck - Wholesome Celebration Trailer
snippet.description:
All Hands on Deck is a cheerful two-player adventure coming soon to Steam. Team up with a friend and work together to explore puzzle-filled worlds, using handy tools and the power of Rock Paper Scissors.

Play the Demo Now and Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2122880/All_Hands_on_Deck

Pre purchase on Nintendo eshop:
NA: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/all-hands-on-deck-switch
EU: https://www.nintendo.com/nl-nl/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/All-Hands-on-Deck-2954542.html
